name: com.therightbag/bags
title: The Right Bag
description: Search 3,000+ travel bags and check any bag against 53 airlines' cabin and under-seat limits.

tools.name: search_bags
tools.description: Find bags in the catalog by type, size, weight, price, laptop size or text, optionally only those that fit every listed airline (as a cabin bag, or under the seat). Returns up to 25 bags with specs and a link to each bag page.

query.description: Words to match in the brand and model name, e.g. "osprey farpoint"

type.description: Bag type. roller = wheeled carry-on suitcase.

airlines.description: Airline names or slugs, e.g. ["Ryanair", "easyjet", "United Airlines"]. Use list_airlines for the full list.

under_seat.description: With airlines: check the free under-seat personal-item limit instead of the cabin-bag limit.

max_weight_kg.description: Maximum empty weight of the bag

min_laptop_in.description: Smallest laptop size the bag must hold, in inches

tools.name: get_bag
tools.description: Full specs of one bag and whether it fits each airline as a cabin bag or under the seat. Pass the slug from search_bags, or a brand and model name.

tools.name: check_bag_fit
tools.description: Check any bag by its size (and optionally its packed weight) against airline limits: under the seat, as a cabin bag, too heavy or too big. Checks every airline unless some are listed.

weight_kg.description: Packed weight, to check weight limits

airlines.description: Airline names or slugs, e.g. ["Ryanair", "easyjet", "United Airlines"]. Use list_airlines for the full list.

tools.name: list_airlines
tools.description: Cabin-bag and under-seat size and weight limits of the airlines tracked, from each airline's own baggage page, with fare notes (fares that include no cabin bag). Pass airlines to get only those.

airlines.description: Airline names or slugs, e.g. ["Ryanair", "easyjet", "United Airlines"]. Use list_airlines for the full list.
